source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: The low/high opposition in syntactic bundling
notes: Next, when complex predicates like xaartyskaqa tüher ‘take a picture of (lit. make something fall on a photograph)’ are marked with the suffix –n-, the only possible reading is benefactive.
en: Keskil took a picture of the plan for himself.
